name: DisequalityDispersion.Machine.suffix_bind
typeText:
∀ {α β : Type} {f : List.{0} Bool → Option.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} α (List.{0} Bool))}
  {g : α → List.{0} Bool → Option.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} β (List.{0} Bool))},
  DisequalityDispersion.Machine.SuffixP f →
    (∀ (a : α), DisequalityDispersion.Machine.SuffixP (g a)) →
      DisequalityDispersion.Machine.SuffixP (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.bindP f g)

source.code:
theorem suffix_bind {α β : Type} {f : List Bool → Option (α × List Bool)}
    {g : α → List Bool → Option (β × List Bool)} (hf : SuffixP f)
    (hg : ∀ a, SuffixP (g a)) : SuffixP (bindP f g) := by
  intro l b rest h
  cases hfl : f l with
  | none => simp [bindP, hfl] at h
  | some q =>
      obtain ⟨a, rest'⟩ := q
      rw [bindP_of_eq hfl] at h
      obtain ⟨pre1, h1⟩ := hf l a rest' hfl
      obtain ⟨pre2, h2⟩ := hg a rest' b rest h
      exact ⟨pre1 ++ pre2, by rw [h1, h2, List.append_assoc]⟩
